tei:div.tei:p: (129)bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyun khyewar bde chen rnam par rol ba'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (130)

bka' brgyad rgyun khyer la/ skyabs sems ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos/ tshogs mchog phyir mi ldog pa la/ byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du/ zhi khro bka' brgyad sgrub nas ni/ gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis/ 'gro don byed par sems bskyed do/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas rgyas/ sogs/ bskyed pa'i rim pa la/ blo mchog rab tu gyur pas ye shes klong dgu'i rtsal chu las rlabs ltar skad cig gis lhar gsal ba dang*/ de tsam mi nus pas tshig gis gsal 'debs pa ni/ hūm̐/ rnam dag byang chub sems kyi ngang nyid las/ sgyu ma'i phyag rgya bye brag cir yang gsal/ rang rig ye shes chos sku mngon du shar/ rang byung rgyu yi yi ge hūm̐ du gsal/ de las 'od 'phros ma dag snang zhen sbyang*/ 'byung lnga rim brtsegs rin chen gzhal yas khang*/ bhrūm̐/ pho brang gcig (131)la gzhal yas khang pa dgu/ bkod pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus/ mthing nag gru gsum e yi rnam pa la/ rtsibs bzhi mu khyud khyabs dang bcas pa'o/ phyi rol 'khor yug dur khrod chen po brgyad/ ngo mtshar kun bzang zhing gi bkod pa rdzogs/ pho brang lte bar baidyūra'i rang bzhin brag 'gro drug sna tshogs padme'i ge sar la/ rab 'bar nyi ma dkar gsal zla ba'i dkyil/ lha brgyad klu brgyad bsnol mar brdzis pa'i steng*/ gdug pa'i gcan gzan seṅge stag gzig dom/ glang chen ma he chu srin sbrul gyi khrir/ gser 'khor bcu gnyis rtsibs ldan lte ba ru/ ma hā de ba mu ma de war bcas/ phyogs mtshams brgyad por padma nyi zla'i steng*/ rū tra chu glang glu dbang lha chen po/ ma mo dar zab dregs pa dgra bgegs rnams/ pho mo kha (132)sbug gnad rkyal bsnol mar gyur/ hūm̐ yig 'phro 'dus rgyu yi he ru ka/ yab yum gsal ba dbus kyi gnas la 'khod/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgra dang ros/

rgyal ba mchod cing sems can kun don byas/ slar yang nyid kyi sku la bsdus pa nas/ bde chen byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu/ chos nyid stong pa'i glu yis bskul pa las/ thig le hūm̐ yig phyag mtshan yongs gyur pa/ khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs dpal chen po/ gnam zhal dbyings phyug yum dang gnyis med 'khril/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med bdag nyid can/ gzi byin bzod dka' 'bar ba'i klong du bzhugs/ bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi sprin spros pas/ stong gsum khro bo'i tshogs kyis dbang ba rnams/ hūm̐ gi sbyor bas rang la kun bsdus nas/ dbyings su thim nas yig 'bru phyag mtshan dgu/ khro bor gyur de (133)phyogs mtshams kun du 'khod/ hūm̐/ dbus phyogs mi 'gyur mthing nag e dbyings su/ khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs dpal chen po/ sgegs pa dpa' ba mi sdug tshul ston cing*/ rgod dang gshed dang 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ snying rje rngams dang zhi ba la sogs pa/ gar dgu'i rnam rol che mchog he ru ka dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi 'dor stabs bsgrad/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing rngam pa'i zhal/ zhal gdang ljags 'dril rdo rje'i mche ba gtsigs/ spyan dgu sdang mig sma ra smin me 'bar/ 'bar ba'i me dpung 'khyogs po'i rnam par 'khrugs/ phyag drug g.yas g.yon rdo rje dung khrag dang*/ rdo rje rtse lnga rtse gsum 'bar ba 'jin/ g.yon gyi lhag ma thod rnyid thod skam thogs/ dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs pa'i pang g.yon du/ gnam (134)zhal dbyings phyug mthing rus rgyan spras/ rdo rje dung khrag yab gyi mgul nas 'khyud/ rtsibs bzhir rigs bzhir khyams la khro bo bcu/ sgo bzhir mthar byed mu ran lce spyang brgyad/ che mchog yon tan lha tshogs 'khor bcas gsal/ hūm̐/ shar phyogs dkyil 'khor dbus su ru tra'i steng*/ yang dag mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal/ phyag drug rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rnge'i chung g.yas/

dril bu bnan dmar rgyu zhags g.yon na bsnams/ kro ti shwa ri kha ṭwāṃ thod 'jin 'khyud/ yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ hūm̐/ lho phyogs dkyil 'khor dbus su chu glung steng*/ gshin rje mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal/ phyag drug be con ral gri dgra st+wa g.yas/ bhan dmar sdig mjub mdung thung g.yon na bsnams/ bāo ta gra st+wa bhan dmar stobs pas 'khyud/ ral gcig rtse (135)gsum thod 'jin g.yas su 'khod/ 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ hūm̐/ nub phyogs dkyil 'khor dbus su klu chen steng*/ rta mgrin dmar nag g.yas dkar g.yon sngo zhal/ phyag drug rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ sbrul zhags g.yas/ dril bu dung dmar lcags sgrogs g.yon na bsnams/ padma gzi 'bar kha ṭwāṃ thod 'jin 'khyud/ g.yas g.yon phra men byi la su shud mgo padmam gsung gi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ hūm̐/ byang phyogs dkyil 'khor dbus su lha chen steng*/ phur pa mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal/ phyag drug g.yas gnyis rtse dgu rtse lnga dang*/ g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭwāṃ mtha' gnyis kyi/ phur bu 'dril 'debs rdo rje'i gshog pa gdengs/ 'khor lo rgyas 'debs kha ṭwāṃ thod 'jin 'khyud/ phur pa phrin las lha tshogs 'khor (136)dang bcas/ hūm̐/ shar lhor dkyil 'khor dbus su ma mo'i steng/ bla med khrag 'thung mthing nag dkar dmar zhal/ phyag drug rdo rje khyung chen sbrul zhags g.yas/ bnan dmar zhing g.yab thod pa'i ga'u g.yon/ mu kha mthing nag zhal lnga dkar ser dmar/ ljang ku mthing nag phyag drug rdo rje dang*/ gri zhags bum pa g.yas 'jin dril bu dang*/ bhan dmar g.yang gzhi yab 'khyud zhabs brgyad bsgrad/ gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon mdun du bkra gsal dang*/ srid ba bde 'gro nyi zla thod phreng can/ ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ hūm̐/ lho nub dkyil 'khor dbus su seng ge'i khrir/ gsang ba'i bdag po rig 'jin rdo rje chos/

dkar gas phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'jin/ dbu skra thor tshugs rin chen cod paṇa can/ zi ldir smad g.yog rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol/ bla ma rig 'jin lha tshogs (137)'khor dang bcas/ hūm̐/ nub byang dkyil 'khor dbus su dregs pa'i steng*/ dregs 'dul mthing nag g.yas ser g.yon smug zhal/ phyag drug rdo rje lha brgyad mgo bo g.yas/ bhan dmar klu brgyad mgo bo yod na bsnams/ khams gsum spyi 'dul kha ṭwāṃ thod 'jin 'khyud/ gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon dbang phyug yab yum sogs/ 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ hūm̐/ byang shar dkyil 'khor dbus su dgra bgegs steng*/ stobs ldan nag po zhal gsum mig sman mdog phyag drug rdo rje lha brgyad tsitta g.yas/ bhan dmar klu brgyad tsirta g.yon na bsnams/ 'byung lnga'i bdag mo mthing nag phyag gnyis kyi/ gzugs khams mkhar 'degs 'dod khams sa gzhir gnon/ dmod pa drags sngags lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ gtso 'khor thugs (138)kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems/ de thugs nyi steng rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐/ so so'i sngags phreng 'bar bas g.yas su 'khor/ dkyil 'khor phyi khyams shar sogs phyos bzhi ru/ zhi rgyas dbang drag ma mo drug drug dang*/ sgo bzhir sgo skyong kun kyang phyogs kyi mdog 'jigs gzugs dur khrod chas ldan rang rtags 'jin/ phyi yi mu khyud mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis/ ging chen bco brgyad laṅga bcu drug dang*/ 'bar ma brgyad dang sa bdag sum cu gnyis/ ma bdun sring bzhi pho nya drug cu bzhi/ mkha' 'gro brtan ma phyogs skyong rgyal chen sogs/ dpal gyi pho nya bsam gyi mi khyab pa/ nyi ma las ni 'od zer ji bzhin du/ rab 'byams nam mkha'i khams kun gang bar gyur/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ khro bo'i rgyal po yo nas yin pa'i phyir/ sku dang gsung dang (139)thugs su byin brlabs pas/ ye shes rnam pa lnga yi dbang bskur ro/

dam tshig ye shes gnyis med gsal nas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dpal chen gtso dgu'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa ma jaḥ hūm̐/ 'og min chos dbyings dbus mtha' med pa nas/ bde gshegs zhi ba dpal chen dkyil 'khor dgu chos kyi dbyings nas 'gro don skur sprul pa'i/ yab yum 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ oṃ shri badzra kro dha he ru ka sa pā ri wa e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya ā be sha ya tiṣṭha lhan/ a ti pū hoḥ pra ti tstsha hoḥ hūm̐/ 'og min chos dbyings mtha' bral zhing khams su/ bde gshegs zhi ba dpal chen he ru ka/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ phyag rgya gar dang phyi nang mchod pa dang*/ sbyor sgrol gtor ma rakta'i (140)mchod pa dang*/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi rdzas kyi mchod pa dang*/ chos nyid rol ba'i mchod pa 'bul lags na/ gnyis med blang dor med par bzhes nas kyang*/ thun mchog rigs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pā ri wa ra ma hā shma sha na puṣpe dhu paṃ de paṃ gandhe n+ya bi dya shabda amṛ ta rakta bha lingta ma hā mu tra bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dharmā dhartu pūtstsha hoḥ hūm̐/ bde gshegs sku lnga'i yon tan rjogs pa'i lha/ 'gro drug dug lnga'i bag chags rgyud sbyong zhing*/ mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba'i skur snang ba/ bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ ye shes klong dgu'i yon tan rjogs pa'i lha/ 'gro drug sgo gsum tshogs brgyad sbyang ba'i lha/ ye shes dbyings las 'bar ba'i skur snang ba/ dpal chen bka' brgyad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ rang gi thugs rin po che zur brgyad (141)sa mchong gur phub pa lta bu'i klong du pad nyi zla ba'i gdan la rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba de'i thugs khar rdo rje sngon po rtse lang ba'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i thig le hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng ba rnams shin tu phra ba'i gzugs kyis gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros/

rgyal ba rnams mchod cing 'gro ba'i don byas/ byin brlabs dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas bdag la thim/ snod bcud dag pa lha dang gzhal yas khang gi rang bzhin dang grags stong rdo rje'i sngags sgras zhing khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ bho dhi tsitta ma hā su wa dzñā na dhartu āḥ oṃ badzra tsaṇṭa sarba duṣṭan ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ci nus mthar mchod bstod dang*/ thun mtshams su tshogs kyi mchod par spro na/ hūm̐/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'jin gyis/ chos kun (142)sgyu ma rig pa las/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gi 'phro 'du las/ tshogs kyi dngos 'jin bsreg gtor bkrus/ slar yang bhrūm̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ 'phros pas mtshan ldan ka pa lar/ bhrūm̐ gyis 'dod yon tshogs su sbyar/ phun tshogs 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs/ bde gshegs rigs lnga'i dam tshig rdzas/ rgya che gting zab lhun stug pa/ ngo mtshar mchod sprin phung por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings 'gyur med 'og min zhing khams nas/ bde gshegs zhi khro bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams/ ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ badzra sa ma ya jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs phud cha gsum du spros te/ dang po mchod pa ni/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi rab rgyan te/ thugs dam bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol/ oṃ (143)ga ṇa tsakra pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa pra titstsha swā hā/ bar bshags pa ni/ bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis/ bag med spyod pas dam las 'gal gyur te/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dang ci 'gal ba/ 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags/ yig brgya bzla/ tshogs tha ma la dmigs bya/ e nṛ tri/ a karṣa ya/ jaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ces 'gugs bstim bgyis la/ hūm̐ jaḥ dpal chen che mchog he ru ka gtum drag pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas/

drag po'i phrin las dus la bab/ ma rung zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs tshogs/ dug gsum srid pa'i btson khang du/ rno dbal 'bar ba'i mtshon cha yis/ gzugs phung rdul phran bzhin du shig rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su spor/ drag sngags po lnga'i mthar/ sarba nṛ tri sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad/ ces bsgral nas/ zhal du bstab pa ni/ dgra bgegs gdug pa (144)bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus/ dug gsum dbyings su sbyangs ba mchod pa'i sprin/ zag med bdud rtsir sbyar te 'bul lags na/ rngams pa'i stabs kyis dgyes par bzhes su gsol/ maṃ sa rakta keṃ ni ri ti aṛṃ pūtstsha khā hā ིsa bstabs so/ de nas tshags la rol/ lhag ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pañtsa amri ta hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ sa brlab/ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ jaḥ sa spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ mkha' 'gro ging ling dbang phyug ma/ ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma brgyan/ pho nya la sogs lhag sdud tshogs/ dpal gyi pham phab 'di gsol la/ sngon tshe dpal gyi bka' lung bzhin/ bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mjod/ oṃ ushtsi ta bha ling ta bhakṣa si swā hā/ zhes phul lo/ he ru ka dpal/ sogs smon lam gdab po/ mthar gtang rag gi don du/ oṃ shri badzra he ru ka sa pā ri wa ra ma hā shma sha na puṣpe dhu paṃ dī paṃ ghandhe ne bi dya (145)shabta pū ja hoḥ ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta khā hī/ ma hā rakta khā hi/ ma hā bla ling ta khā hi/ zhes dang*/ yang dag 'jam dpal gshin rje padma dbang*/ rdo rje gzhon nu bla med he ru kaḥ che mchog rig 'jin dregs 'dul drag sngags sogs/ bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ yi ge brgya bas nongs pa bshags/ tshogs mgron rnams rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ yod na bdag nyid dam ye dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor gas btab pa/ hūm̐/ gsum gyis 'od gsal gyi dbyings su bsdu/ phaṭa/ gsum gyis bdag nyid lhar ldang ba'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyi mtshan pas rdo rje go khrab bzhu blugs kyis bsrung bar bsam mo/

oṃ/ mi gnas ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ 'gyur ba med pa lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ rab 'byams rgyal ba rnams kyi gnas thob nas/ 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du 'gyur bar shog ces dang*/ byin (146)brlabs mchog rtsol rtsa brgyad bla ma dang*/ dngos grub char 'bebs zhi khro bka' brgyad lha/ dregs pa'i sde dpon dam can gter srung sogs/ rab 'byams dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog ces shis pa ci rigs pa brjod par bya'o/ ces pa 'di dang dpal yul bla ma shri ma'i mtshan gyis bskul ngor dang*/ gzhan yang rang gi slob bu le lo can mang po mi spro nyung ngu'i yid mi tshim par rnams kyis bskul ngor gter chen gsungs las byang bde chen rnam rol nas tshig sna bsdus te padma las 'brel rtsal gyis rang gnas ljog pa lung gi ri khrod du re gzigs su bstar ba dge legs 'phel/// /
